reproducibility.assessment: Script has deterministic seed, unchanged geometry signature check, triangle-index/barycentric surface-frame attachment, editable hair curves and a temporary-armature proof routine. This is code inspection, not an independently executed rebuild.
reproducibility.restriction: Reapplication requires same object name, topology, local coordinates and rest pose. Root attachment is equivalent custom Geometry Nodes reconstruction, no UV added. Final deformation_check must correspond to selected iteration.

mask_audit.primary: Broad spatial masks include dark interior coat and bright strand tips, with eye/horn/white/background/plume exclusions. Tail correction is plausible. Outer fur silhouette is conservatively omitted, so primary numeric match is interior-mask evidence, not complete silhouette luminance.
mask_audit.limitations: Manual dorsal expansion adds7.49percent render area and1.59percent sheet area, because primary render mask leaves more dense visible edge hair out. Fine gaps and antialiasing mix background with fur, especially sharp sheet points. No luminance threshold was used. Expansion does not replace primary calibration and cannot prove exact silhouette match.
